answer: Because the timing is logged against the shale challenge, the umber audit can replay the lotus history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 117 submissions and hold each account open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 148 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A badge costs paper; the face behind it costs more.
